en.html:
Muramasa's cry represented my feelings without omission.

Hikaru's shield must be equivalent to the magnetic barrier we used—negative-pole magnetic armor. That she could use it was not surprising in itself.

But fighting with it deployed all the time—

Muramasa's magnetic barrier consumed enormous heat. While it was up, very little power remained for flight and other functions.

Normally, therefore, we judged the instant an enemy attack would strike and deployed it only then.

Keep it up continuously, and one could answer any surprise attack. In exchange, machine performance fell drastically. Not merely reduced combat capacity—proper flight itself would probably become impossible.

In other words.

ja.html:
村正の悲鳴は、俺の心境を丸々代弁していた。

　光の言う<ruby>辰気障壁<rt>たて</rt></ruby>とは、<ruby>村正<rt>おれたち</rt></ruby>の用いる磁気障壁――
負極の磁装と同等のものだろう。
　それが使えること自体は、何ら驚くに値しない。

　しかし。
　常に障壁を張り巡らせながら戦っていた、となると
――

　村正の磁気障壁は多大な熱量を必要とする。
　従って障壁の展開中は、騎航その他の機能に割ける
余力が極めて少なくなる。

　ために通常、磁気障壁は敵騎の攻撃を浴びる一瞬を
見切ってその間のみ展開することになる。

　もしもこれを常時張れば、敵手がどう不意を打って
きても対応できる代わり、騎体性能が激減する。
　総じて戦闘能力は低下する――どころではなく騎航
すらまともに行えなくなるだろう。

　<ruby>つまり<rt>・・・</rt></ruby>。

I could see nothing.

Understand nothing.

...How could such a thing be possible?

Silver Star's attack speed had always overwhelmed me. Even so, unable though I was to react, I could at least recognize an attack at the instant it came.

I could understand that I had been attacked.

...Now even that was beyond me.

When, from where, how had she struck?
Even looking back afterwards, I could not understand at all.

————How could such a thing!!
